fields.title: 7. Three data points to check directly before the next issue (monthly 2026-12, 12/01)
fields.md:
1. **Court records in CREW v. Hegseth** — case number, judge, motion for preliminary injunction, and whether the Department of Defense has answered or filed a FACA charter. The sentence in the original complaint that mentions SpaceX, and the basis for the calculation of '19 of 21' ([CREW lawsuit page](https://www.citizensforethics.org/legal-action/lawsuits/new-lawsuit-challenges-hegseths-illegal-future-of-warfare-committee/) · [Complaint PDF](https://www.citizen.org/wp-content/uploads/CREW-v-DoD-Complaint.pdf)).
2. **Musk's SGE status and the 10-K risk factors** — whether the Department of Defense or OGE has disclosed it, and whether language about 'the CEO's government role' appears in Item 1A of the 4Q26 10-K (estimated 2027-02). Input for deciding whether to add a milestone to Axis E ([EDGAR](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json)).
3. **Existing checkpoints retained** — T7 ⓓ 11/5 · ⓔ 11/6 · ⓒ 11/18 · T8 ② deposit 11/4 · acceptance 11/5 · T3 Flight 15 (NET November) · T4 Vulcan LV-01 11/13 · LE-04 11/23 · T9·T10 12/01 ([FAA Starship license](https://www.faa.gov/space/stakeholder_engagement/spacex_starship) · `data/spacex_watch.json launches.competitor_next` · [DA 26-1078](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-1078A1.txt)).
